improvement_reason: The original code effectively creates a combo chart with a bar chart for 'Tax Rate %' and a line chart for 'Slope' over 'Tax Year'. However, there are a few areas for improvement: 1) The color contrast between the bar and line chart can be enhanced for better visibility. 2) Adding legends to the chart will help in identifying the data series more clearly. 3) The x-axis labels can be rotated for better readability if there are many years. 4) The chart's layout can be adjusted to ensure that all elements are clearly visible without overlap.
original_query: Generate a combo chart to visualize 'Tax Rate %' and 'Slope' over 'Tax Year'.
optimized_code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Plotting the bar chart for 'Tax Rate %'
ax1.bar(df['Tax Year'], df['Tax Rate %'], color='skyblue', label='Tax Rate %')
ax1.set_xlabel('Tax Year')
ax1.set_ylabel('Tax Rate %', color='blue')
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='blue')

# Creating a second y-axis for 'Slope'
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(df['Tax Year'], df['Slope'], color='darkred', marker='o', label='Slope')
ax2.set_ylabel('Slope', color='darkred')
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='darkred')

# Adding legends
ax1.legend(loc='upper left')
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')

# Rotating x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

plt.title('Tax Rate % and Slope Over Tax Years')
fig.tight_layout()

# Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Tax Year', 'y_fields': ['Tax Rate %', 'Slope'], 'chart_type': 'comboChart'}
plt.show()
